title: C2 Scheduler-Context Issuer — Typed Issue/Deny/Audit Decision Record
description: One outcome emitted by the confined aq-c2-scheduler-context-issuer service (scripts/ai/lib/scheduler_context_issuer.py::mint_scheduler_context() and its transport wrapper) for a single presented-lease mint attempt, or a periodic health/observability audit record (Foundation C, C2-SCI design rev4, §5 Service Coverage). Observability contract only — the issuer itself never blocks on this schema; a producer/consumer mismatch is a bug to fix in the producer, never a reason to widen this schema. NEVER carries a signature, private/public key material, the presented lease's or minted context's full body, a prompt, or a filesystem path — additionalProperties:false and the enum-bounded reason/latency_bucket fields are intentional; context_id/lease_id are opaque correlation identifiers only (matches the precedent set by execution-cell-adapter-receipt.schema.json's receipt_id/grant_digest pair), never security-bearing detail.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) this decision was emitted.

decision.description: 'issue' = a scheduler-lease-context was minted and signed. 'deny' = mint_scheduler_context() (or the transport frame layer in front of it) refused to mint — see `reason`. 'audit' = a periodic health/observability record carrying no mint attempt (e.g. signer-key-availability self-check).

reason.description: Machine-stable reason code. The first ten mirror scheduler_context_issuer.py's MINT_OK/DENY_* constants exactly; the transport-layer codes (request-oversize .. handler-error) mirror scheduler_context_transport.py's DENY_* constants; 'audit-heartbeat' is the only code paired with decision='audit'.

context_id.description: The minted context's own `context_id` (`sched-ctx::<lease_id>::<grant_digest>`) when decision='issue', else null. An opaque correlation identifier, not a secret.

lease_id.description: The presented lease's own `lease_id` when it was readable far enough to extract one (issue, or a deny reason after lease parsing succeeded), else null (e.g. request-malformed-lease, transport-layer denies before any lease reached the issuer, or audit).

issued_at.description: The minted context's own `issued_at` when decision='issue' (equals `ts`), else null.

latency_bucket.description: Bounded, low-cardinality processing-time bucket for this decision (request receipt to response send). Never a raw millisecond value (unbounded cardinality); 'unknown' covers audit records and any path where latency was not measured.
